ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with high-intensity pixels limited to specular reflections and water spray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 60 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire visible trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits more pronounced pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderately convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes, tapering towards the distal tips.
